questions.stem: Why is blood flow slowest in the capillaries?

options.text: Because capillaries have the thickest walls
Because capillaries are the furthest from the heart and have a huge total cross-sectional area
Because capillaries contain valves that slow the blood
Because blood cells cannot fit through capillaries

questions.explanation: Blood flows slowly through capillaries because they are far from the heart (low pressure) and there are so many of them that the total cross-sectional area is very large. Slow flow allows more time for exchange of substances with tissues.
